subtitle: The smart way to manage industrial data and business processes in the era of digital transformation.
title: IIoT Solutions
description: Siskon Data Collection System, which is a modular management system; collects, reports and notifies production, quality, process and energy data from your business processes in real-time, accurately and automatically. It provides the necessary data flow to decision support systems.
benefitsTitle: What Are the Features of the Systems?

subSystems.title: Production Data Collection System
subSystems.spot: Guarantee success with real-time efficiency tracking!
subSystems.desc: Collects production counts, scrap, downtime and root causes in real time to enable efficiency, OEE, KPI, cycle-time and bottleneck analytics.

subSystems.title: Quality Data Collection System
subSystems.desc: Automatically gathers quality and laboratory data from production environments, helping standardize quality processes and improve product quality.

subSystems.title: Process Data Collection System
subSystems.spot: Manage process data and increase your operational power!
subSystems.desc: Collects pressure, temperature, speed, flow, pH and similar process parameters on event/time basis for real-time and historical analysis.

subSystems.title: Energy Data Collection System
subSystems.spot: Reduce costs with data-driven energy management!
subSystems.desc: Captures consumption, voltage, current and frequency data to monitor, analyze and optimize energy usage while supporting ISO 50001 processes.
